resources.string: Tasks and sessions you explicitly keep running in the background
vivo hides the switch in Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management. Allow Deep Student to run in the background there.
iQOO hides the switch in Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management. Allow Deep Student to run in the background there.
OPPO hides the switch in Settings → Battery → App battery management. Allow Deep Student to run in the background there.
OnePlus hides the switch in Settings → Battery → Battery optimization → Deep Student. Choose Do not optimize.
realme hides the switch in Settings → Battery → App battery management. Allow Deep Student to run in the background there.
Xiaomi hides the switch in Settings → Apps → Deep Student → Battery saver. Choose No restrictions.
Redmi hides the switch in Settings → Apps → Deep Student → Battery saver. Choose No restrictions.
Huawei hides the switch in Settings → Battery → App launch. Set Deep Student to Manage manually with background running allowed.
HONOR hides the switch in Settings → Battery → App launch. Set Deep Student to Manage manually with background running allowed.
Samsung hides the switch in Settings → Battery → Background usage limits. Make sure Deep Student is not in Sleeping apps.
Meizu hides the switch in Settings → Battery → Power management. Allow Deep Student to run in the background.
